repos.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
repos.description: The agent that grows with you
repos.one_liner: A highly adaptive, scalable AI agent framework designed for continuous learning and growth.
bullets: Built on a modular Python architecture designed for long-term agentic memory and task persistence.
Focuses on self-improving workflows that evolve based on user interaction patterns.
Ideal for complex automation tasks requiring deep context retention and iterative problem-solving.
Leverages state-of-the-art LLM integration to serve as a persistent digital assistant.

repos.name: tinyhumansai/openhuman
repos.description: Your Personal AI super intelligence. A brain that builds a local-first memory of your life, a fantastic orchestrator of agent fleets and workflows, and a deep researcher.
repos.one_liner: A local-first personal AI orchestrator that manages agent fleets and builds a private memory of your life.
bullets: Written in Rust for high-performance, local-first data processing and memory management.
Acts as a central orchestrator for multi-agent systems, enabling complex workflow delegation.
Prioritizes user privacy by maintaining a local-first knowledge base and memory store.
Designed for deep research and personal productivity automation.

repos.name: wafer-ai/gpu-perf-engineering-resources
repos.description: A curriculum for learning about gpu performance engineering, from scratch to what the frontier AI labs do
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive curriculum for mastering GPU performance engineering, mirroring techniques used by frontier AI labs.
bullets: Curated educational resource covering hardware architecture, memory bandwidth, and kernel optimization.
Provides a structured path from foundational concepts to advanced performance tuning for LLM training.
Essential for infrastructure engineers and quant developers working on high-throughput AI workloads.
Includes practical methodologies for profiling and bottleneck analysis in GPU-accelerated environments.

repos.name: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
repos.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
repos.one_liner: A terminal-based interface providing free access to advanced coding models like Claude Code and Codex.
bullets: Python-based utility that abstracts API interactions for multiple coding-focused LLMs.
Supports voice-to-code functionality and cross-platform integration (IDE, terminal, mobile).
Enables developers to leverage high-end agentic coding tools without immediate per-token costs.
Useful for rapid prototyping and integrating AI-assisted coding into existing dev workflows.

repos.name: virgiliojr94/book-to-skill
repos.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
repos.one_liner: A tool that converts technical PDF documentation and books into actionable skills for Claude Code.
bullets: Python-based pipeline that parses technical literature into structured agent-ready knowledge.
Allows developers to 'teach' their AI agents specific proprietary or niche technical domains.
Enhances agentic performance by providing domain-specific context for coding and debugging tasks.
Streamlines the process of keeping AI assistants updated with the latest technical documentation.
